identity: Blue-white spells-matter midrange. Tura Kennerud, Skyknight and Raff, Weatherlight Stalwart share one trigger condition - casting an instant or sorcery - and this list contains 14 of them across 23 nonland cards, so the interaction suite IS the token engine: every Negate, Impulse and Destroy Evil is also a 1/1 Soldier and, with Raff online, a card. Captain's Call is the bridge between the two halves, a sorcery that makes three Soldiers on its own and four with Tura out, and Valiant Veteran makes every one of those Soldiers a 2/2. This is the only deck of the four that answers the stack; it wins by accumulating a Soldier board behind counterspells while Haughty Djinn grows with the graveyard.

restrictions.extra_constraint: max 5 rare/mythic cards total across mainboard + sideboard

mainboard.name: Shore Up
mainboard.oracle_text: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains hexproof until end of turn. Untap it. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
mainboard.role: Fuel/protection - hexproof saves an engine legend; triggers Tura and Raff

mainboard.name: Timely Interference
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{R} (You may pay an additional {1}{R} as you cast this spell.)
Target creature gets -1/-0 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature blocks this turn if able.
Draw a card.
mainboard.role: Fuel - draws a card unconditionally, no Raff tax (red kicker declined)

mainboard.name: Raff, Weatherlight Stalwart
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may tap two untapped creatures you control. If you do, draw a card.
{3}{W}{W}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn.
mainboard.role: Payoff/engine - a card per instant or sorcery; {3}{W}{W} pumps the board

mainboard.name: Resolute Reinforcements
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flash (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.)
When this creature enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
mainboard.role: Enabler - flash, TWO untapped bodies, which is exactly Raff's tap-two cost

mainboard.name: Valiant Veteran
mainboard.oracle_text:
Other Soldiers you control get +1/+1.
{3}{W}{W}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Soldier you control.
mainboard.role: Payoff - Soldier anthem; every token this deck makes is a Soldier

mainboard.name: Impulse
mainboard.oracle_text: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
mainboard.role: Fuel/selection - finds an engine legend and triggers the one already out

mainboard.name: Negate
mainboard.role: Interaction/fuel - counters a noncreature spell and makes a Soldier

mainboard.name: Destroy Evil
mainboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater.
• Destroy target enchantment.
mainboard.role: Interaction/fuel - kills a fat blocker or an enchantment, and makes a Soldier

mainboard.name: Protect the Negotiators
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {W} (You may pay an additional {W} as you cast this spell.)
If this spell was kicked, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1} for each creature you control.
mainboard.role: Interaction/fuel - counters ANY spell; kicked it also makes a Soldier

mainboard.name: Haughty Djinn
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Haughty Djinn's power is equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
mainboard.role: Payoff - flier whose power is the spell count; discounts every instant and sorcery

mainboard.name: Soaring Drake
mainboard.role: Threat - a 2/3 flier body and a Raff tap target

mainboard.name: Tolarian Geyser
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {W} (You may pay an additional {W} as you cast this spell.)
Return target creature to its owner's hand. Draw a card. If this spell was kicked, you gain 3 life.
mainboard.role: Interaction/fuel - bounce plus a card, and a Soldier

mainboard.name: Captain's Call
mainboard.oracle_text: Create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
mainboard.role: Payoff/fuel - a SORCERY, so three Soldiers become four with Tura out

mainboard.name: Tura Kennerüd, Skyknight
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
mainboard.role: Payoff - a 1/1 Soldier for every instant and sorcery cast

mainboard.name: Idyllic Beachfront
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {W} or {U}.)
This land enters tapped.

mainboard.name: Adarkar Wastes
mainboard.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add {W} or {U}. This land deals 1 damage to you.
mainboard.role: WU painland - the only untapped WU dual in the pool

sideboard.name: Citizen's Arrest
sideboard.oracle_text: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
sideboard.role: Unconditional exile of a creature or planeswalker

sideboard.name: Prayer of Binding
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flash
When this enchantment enters, exile up to one target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. You gain 2 life.
sideboard.role: Flash exile of any nonland permanent
sideboard.when_to_board: vs artifact and enchantment decks and single-bomb decks

sideboard.name: Essence Scatter
sideboard.when_to_board: vs creature-dense decks where Negate is dead

sideboard.name: Frostfist Strider
sideboard.oracle_text:
Ward {2} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.)
When this creature enters, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
sideboard.role: 4/4 ward 2 that taps and stun-counters a creature on entry
sideboard.when_to_board: vs decks that win with one big attacker, and vs removal-heavy decks

sideboard.name: Anointed Peacekeeper
sideboard.oracle_text:
Vigilance
As this creature enters, look at an opponent's hand, then choose any card name.
Spells your opponents cast with the chosen name cost {2} more to cast.
Activated abilities of sources with the chosen name cost {2} more to activate unless they're mana abilities.
sideboard.role: Names a card and taxes it {2}; a 3/3 vigilance body
sideboard.when_to_board: vs combo decks and vs a known bomb

sideboard.name: Aether Channeler
sideboard.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, choose one —
• Create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying.
• Return another target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
• Draw a card.
sideboard.role: Modal - Bird token, bounce a nonland permanent, or draw
sideboard.when_to_board: vs matchups needing flexibility; the bounce mode answers an otherwise unanswerable permanent

identity_es: Midrange azul-blanco de los hechizos importan. Tura Kennerud, Skyknight y Raff, Weatherlight Stalwart comparten una condición de disparo — lanzar un instantáneo o conjuro — y esta lista contiene 14 de ellos entre 23 cartas no-tierra, así que el paquete de interacción ES el motor de fichas: cada Negate, Impulse y Destroy Evil es además un Soldado 1/1 y, con Raff activo, una carta. Captain's Call es el puente entre ambas mitades, un conjuro que crea tres Soldados por sí solo y cuatro con Tura fuera, y Valiant Veteran convierte a cada uno de esos Soldados en un 2/2. Este es el único mazo de los cuatro que responde en la pila; gana acumulando un tablero de Soldados tras contrahechizos mientras Haughty Djinn crece con el cementerio.
